title: ParseResultBytes.unsplit() crashes for any URI without an authority
property: unsplitting a parsed relative/authority-less URI (bytes) returns the URI bytes instead of raising
actual: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'encode' raised in ParseResultBytes.authority (parseresult.py:409), because reference.authority is None
evidence: unsplit is documented as ':returns: The parsed URI reconstituted as a string / :rtype: bytes'; the str counterpart ParseResult.unsplit and geturl() work for the same input, and authority-less URIs such as '/a', 'a:b', '?q' and '' are valid RFC 3986 references that from_string accepts. ParseResultMixin declares authority as Optional.
